_note: Profiles are presets of independent settings. Ladders run cheapest first; escalation only on a failed objective check. Technical first rungs: tool-free tasks try lean mode (pilot_v2: ~96% fewer tokens per correct, its one miss caught by the check); tool tasks try only their toolset (pilot_toolset_v1: 6/6 vs 6/6 correct, -77% tokens per correct). General/important have no check, so they never start minimal. Hygiene only for hygiene_agents on tool runs; off by default: Lambda's counterbalanced A/B (2026-11-10, 5 Codex coding tasks x 3 pairs, 15/15 pass both ways) measured +8% weighted tokens and +10% time with it. The pilot_v2 -36% (3 tasks x 2) did not replicate.

toolset_args._note: Tools a none/read/code rung never needs. Measured 2026-11-10 (codex-cli 0.164.0, trivial question): fixed input 16,926 -> 11,549 per model turn (web search 2,456; plugins 2,006). Live A/B ab_codex_toolset_v1 (6 coding tasks x 3 pairs): 18/18 vs 18/18 pass, tokens -32.7%, weighted -29%, time -19%.

hygiene_instruction: Keep tool output short: use quiet or summary flags, limit long output with head, tail or grep, and pipe long logs through `{python} {compact}` before reading them. Do not re-read output you have already seen.

technical.lean_system_prompt: You are a precise assistant. Answer the question directly.

_note_retry: A transient API/network error is retried once on the same rung (same model, same files) before the ladder treats it as a failed attempt; otherwise an outage escalates to a pricier model. Claude Code already retries API errors internally before exiting, so one short extra try is enough. The harness's own timeout is never retried.

report_weights._note: Illustrative weighted_tokens = new input + cached_input*w + output*w. Not prices; budgets use total tokens.
